routing_decision_rules.execution_boundary: No access, approval, send, or tool execution is granted.
routing_decision_rules.trigger: safety, security, protected access, approval, or authority ambiguity
routing_decision_rules.why: Guardian owns fail-closed risk and authority review.

routing_decision_rules.execution_boundary: No autonomous launch from Mission Control; explicit package preview first.
routing_decision_rules.why: Implementation workers need a compiled package with explicit paths, tests, stop conditions, and receipts.

routing_decision_rules.execution_boundary: No publishing, release, catalog mutation, or external music-service tool use.
routing_decision_rules.trigger: music, art, Struna, album metadata, creative production
routing_decision_rules.why: Niles owns music/art context; Codex only joins for implementation artifacts.

routing_decision_rules.execution_boundary: No Gmail, calendar, Coupa, send, submit, or approval authority.
routing_decision_rules.trigger: communications, finance/AP, email, calendar, or Capital Hilton-style workflow review
routing_decision_rules.why: Cassandra owns comms/finance visibility; Guardian joins for approval/protected-access implications.

routing_decision_rules.execution_boundary: Advisory only; no code execution or authority grant.
routing_decision_rules.trigger: doctrine, app architecture, system coherence, horizon checks
routing_decision_rules.why: Hermes reviews coherence and doctrine, often paired with Chief for build posture.

routing_decision_rules.execution_boundary: No repair, queue execution, or hidden worker activation.
routing_decision_rules.trigger: work-board, check-engine, queue posture, active build coordination
routing_decision_rules.why: Chief owns coordination and diagnostic posture.

routing_decision_rules.execution_boundary: This contract cannot execute the decision.
routing_decision_rules.trigger: final action, approval, send, submit, credential, or irreversible decision
routing_decision_rules.why: Operator remains final authority; Guardian supplies boundary review.

routing_decision_rules.execution_boundary: Preview-only until live chat/workspace routing is separately gated.
routing_decision_rules.trigger: cross-domain ambiguity, major doctrine shift, or pre-security audit review
routing_decision_rules.why: All-agent review is a future review mode for broad system posture, not live group chat.
